verdicts.reason: A has a strong left-to-right banner hierarchy (big headline, clear CTA on the right), but the headphones are cramped into a narrow left strip and clipped at the edge. The body line is tiny (~9px) and the 'OBSIDIAN ONE' eyebrow is demoted to an inline afterthought, while the logo is oversized. B places the small OBSIDIAN logo directly on the busy city skyline, which hurts legibility and brand. The headphone earcup jams against the panel edge, and the eyebrow is blown up larger than the body copy, so the hierarchy and reading order are muddled.
